text:
Priya (VP Eng): quick follow-up from the runtime part of the all-hands — can we get a concrete timeline for the KV cache rollout and how it ties into batching improvements?
Mateo (Runtime): timeline: alpha next week, beta in ~6 weeks, GA in ~12 weeks. main blocker is kernel parity for quantized models.
Sara (Product): product question: will the KV cache be opt-in per-route or global? customers want per-route control.
Mateo (Runtime): per-route toggle. default=on for recent model variants, opt-out via route config.
Jin (Infra): ops note: rolling the cache requires a migration plan for existing GPU pools; we'll need a coord window to warm caches. thinking: warm during low-traffic hours + canary 5% traffic.
Lee (SRE): can we avoid node autoscaler thrash if caches cause memory pressure? last time we saw OOM churn.
Alex (ML): kernel side: need KV layout changes for 8-bit kernels. current kernels assume contiguous KV layout; we'll introduce a compatibility path but perf differs ~5-12% depending on seq len.
Mateo (Runtime): yes — two kernel tracks: legacy KV and new compact-KV. fallback policy: if compact-KV not available, route to quantized-compat model with slightly higher latency.
Priya (VP Eng): we need clear SLO impact numbers for the fallback policy. can you summarize expected p50/p95 delta?
Mateo (Runtime): rough numbers: p50 +3ms, p95 +18ms on 2048 context for compact-KV; fallback to quantized-compat: p50 +8ms, p95 +45ms. will run more runs this week.
Sara (Product): please tag those as "expected" and include workload assumptions. customers will want the baseline.
Jin (Infra): action item for infra: prepare a canary pool with compact-KV enabled and increased swap limit. I'll own capacity config.
Lee (SRE): action item: I'll add alerting for cache-fill-rate and node-memory-pressure; thresholds TBD after canary.
Mateo (Runtime): config snippet we'll use for canary (rough):
```
route: /generate/newsletter
enabled_cache: true
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 64
  latency_target_ms: 120
```
Mateo (Runtime): note: batcher tuning interacts with cache hit rate; higher max_batch_size helps throughput but can push latency if cache miss rate spikes.
Alex (ML): question for product/leadership: do we accept a small p95 regression for 10-20% cost reduction via more aggressive compact kernels? tradeoff is cost vs p95.
Priya (VP Eng): leadership preference: prioritize customer-facing SLOs first; however we should quantify cost savings and consider gated rollout for internal customers. present numbers in next roadmap update.
Sara (Product): I'll add a customer-facing note and prepare 2 templates: "recommended" and "aggressive-cost-savings" configs.
Mateo (Runtime): follow-ups I'll post in eng-runtime with perf runs and kernel benchmarks. expect PRs for rollout config and a short RFC for compact-KV.
OpsBot: Canary deployment scheduled by Jin at 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z (automated).
Lee (SRE): tiny ask: can someone add a short blurb in the canary doc about rollback steps? last-minute rollbacks are messy.
Mateo (Runtime): will add rollback steps + a health-check endpoint that gates traffic.
Jin (Infra): once alpha is stable, I'll post a proposed low-traffic window and the exact pool sizes.
Priya (VP Eng): thanks everyone. please post links to the benchmark doc and canary run in this thread when available. :thumbsup:
Mateo (Runtime): will do. (reaction :thumbsup:)
Sara (Product): adding to roadmap board: "KV cache canary -> opt-in per-route -> GA" with owners.
Alex (ML): ping me if you want extra kernel runs for specific model families.
Priya (VP Eng): closing thread — retro notes expected after canary.
